Product Features

  • Height Adjustable Headboard: The geometrically shaped upholstered headboard panel adds a modern feel to the bedroom.The height of the headboard is adjustable, and the adjustable height range is about 10cm. Difference.Those with different heights can find the best comfort point by adjusting the height of the headboard. The applicable mattress thickness is about 25-35 cm.
  • LED lighting: LED lighting adds modern style to your bedroom, with remote control you can change the different colors and brightness for comfortable lying.
  • Storage Design: The bed is equipped with 4 large capacity drawers. Two sides of the bed are equipped with drawer buckles that allow the drawer to be firmly attached to the bed when the drawer is not in use, so that your bedroom is tidy. The storage boxes are easy to roll out and roll in thanks to the wheels on the bottom.
  • Practicality meets design: Bed skilfully combines elegant design and maximum comfort. Decorative decorative knobs refine the headboard and give it a modern touch.The frame of the bed is mainly made of iron, is durable and has a load capacity of up to 600 LBS. The additional support legs of the center bar can ensure the reliable stability of the bed.
  • Detailed information: To avoid damage, this bed frame is shipped in three packages, so it can arrive in several partial shipments. If all three packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact our customer service. Please lift the bed frame during transport and do not pull it across the floor.
